items.title: Breakpoints aur watches ka istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Using Breakpoints and Watches (PDF 66, printed 62), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Breakpoints aur watches debugging ke tools hain jin se program ka rawayya (behaviour) samjha jata hai. In se program ko chuni hui jagah par rok kar (pause) data dekha ja sakta hai. Yeh ghaltiyan pehchanne aur code ka bahao (flow) samajhne mein madad dete hain, aur debugging ko tez aur zyada durust banate hain.

items: Breakpoints program ko rokte hain; watches variables dikhati hain.
Dono debugging ko tez aur durust banate hain.
